Read out of saint.gr's line for 13 Ιουνίου, «Οσία Αλεξάνδρα Ηγουμένη και θεμελιώτρια της Μονής Ντιβέεβο», with the rank word and the office left off.

Read out of the name link behind the calendar's line for 13 июня ст. ст., name page 14272, «Александра (Мельгунова) Дивеевская, прп.», with the rank word left off. death.note: doxologia.ro's life: «Domnul a chemat-o la Sine în ziua de 13 iunie 1789.» The same page dates her birth only as «începutul secolului al XVIII-lea», which is not a year, so no birth interval is recorded.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 13 июня ст. ст. — «Прп. Александры Дивеевской (1789).»

attestations.note: The day's second entry. The same menologion number this folder's romanian and greek rows already carry, so there is no second day and no note is owed. The line gives 1789, the year the folder already holds off doxologia's life; `dates` was not touched. THE CALENDAR PRINTS NO LIFE PAGE for her — her name link, page 14272, has no Житие beside it — AND NO HYMN UNDER HER NAME. Four hymns on this day name an «Александр»: they are the joint troparion and kontakion of the five icon painters of Moscow, and that Alexander is one of those men and NOT this woman; none of the four is recorded here. This upgrade adds the day and the `ru` name form only. Not checked: azbyka.ru.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 13 iunie — «Sfânta Alexandra Schimonahia, Stareța și Întemeietoarea Mănăstirii Diveevo»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 13ης Ιουνίου — «Οσία Αλεξάνδρα Ηγουμένη και θεμελιώτρια της Μονής Ντιβέεβο»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 13 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and dates her «(; - 1789)». It is plainly the same woman: Agatha Semyonovna Melgunova, widowed young, tonsured in 1760 at the Florovsky monastery of Kiev with the name Alexandra, sent by a vision of the Mother of God to found a new house, who settled at Diveevo near Sarov and died there on 13 June 1789. The page records her relics at the monastery of Diveevo. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence, and no hymn.
